propositions: Rebar lacks a native Bedrock provider and currently routes Claude through OpenAI-compatible gateways, losing prompt caching and native structured output
Prompt caching on Bedrock is model-dependent and fails silently—some inference profiles write and read cache tokens while others silently bill full input tokens with no error signal

Temperature parameter is rejected with 400 ValidationException on some Bedrock models (e.g. opus-4-7) but not others, breaking Pass-2 verify steps that deliberately set temperature=0 for greedy determinism

The capability layer must distinguish per-model sampling-parameter support via an exact-id override table (_MODEL_ID_CAPABILITY_OVERRIDES) separate from profile-shaped predicates to preserve f184's signed contract
A cache-ineffectiveness warning must fire when caching was requested but both cache_read and cache_write tokens remain zero while input_tokens > 0, preventing silent full-price billing

The Bedrock builder must live in a new leaf module (bedrock_model.py) with a [bedrock] optional extra to keep boto3 out of the default [agents] install, and Bedrock-produced inference profiles are the only invokable model ids in the measured account/region
